entries.source_jp:

entries.official_en:
A modest stronghold built on the North
Chronos route that cuts across the desert.
entries.canonical_en: A relatively simple checkpoint on the North Chronos Road, which runs east to west along the desert's edge.

entries.source_jp:
カーラ神殿に至る街道を監視するために
山間部の入り口に設けられた関
entries.official_en:
A stronghold built in the mountains to
monitor the road to Kalla's temple.
entries.canonical_en: A checkpoint at the entrance to the mountains, built to watch the road to Cara's temple.

entries.source_jp:

険しい山間部に設けられた関
entries.official_en:
A stronghold built in the rugged mountains
between Castalia and Idyia.
entries.canonical_en: A checkpoint built in the rugged mountains on the border between the Castalia and Idyia regions.

entries.source_jp:
ランバス地方の大きな淡水湖
湖面に映るジュラ神殿の景観は有名
entries.official_en:
A large freshwater lake in Lambath.
Jurah's temple reflects on its surface.
entries.canonical_en: A large freshwater lake in the Lambuth region, famous for the reflection of Jurah Temple on its surface.

entries.source_jp:
カスタリア地方最大の大瀑布
財宝が隠されているという伝説がある
entries.official_en:
The largest waterfall in Castalia. Legend has
it that behind it lies hidden treasure.
entries.canonical_en: Castalia's largest waterfall. Legend says treasure is hidden here.

entries.source_jp:
伝説の吟遊詩人コーエンの墓所
特徴的な構造から廊とも呼ばれる
entries.official_en:
The tomb of Cohen, the legendary bard.
Its structure is often compared to a gallery's.
entries.canonical_en: The tomb of Cohen, the legendary bard, also called a gallery because of its distinctive structure.

entries.source_jp:
森の中の小さな滝。美しい精霊から
神託を得られるという噂がある
entries.official_en:
A small waterfall. Legend has it that visitors
can hear prophecies from a gorgeous spirit.
entries.canonical_en: A small waterfall in the forest where a beautiful spirit is said to grant oracles.

entries.source_jp:
塩水をたたえた塩湖。塩分濃度が高く、
そのままでは飲用には適さない
entries.official_en:
A lake filled with salty waters that are
decidedly not potable.
entries.canonical_en: A saltwater lake whose high salt concentration makes its water unsuitable for drinking.

entries.source_jp:
黒い湿原とも呼ばれる数百年前の古戦場跡
濃い霧が出ると亡者が蘇ると言われる
entries.official_en:
A battle was fought here centuries ago, and
its dead are said to reappear in the fog.
entries.canonical_en: A centuries-old battlefield also called the Black Marsh. The dead are said to rise when thick fog settles.

entries.source_jp:
砂漠の縁にある交易路
外れると砂漠に迷い込む危険な道
entries.official_en:
A trade route at the edge of the desert,
known to lead travelers astray.
entries.canonical_en: A trade route along the desert's edge. Straying from the road risks getting lost in the desert.

entries.source_jp:
シドニア郡の大部分を占める山岳地帯
山を切り拓いて街道が作られている
entries.official_en:
A mountainous region composing most of
Cydonia. A road was cut through it.
entries.canonical_en: A mountainous region occupying most of Cydonia County. A road has been cut through the mountains.

entries.source_jp:
住人に放棄され、忘れられた集落跡
土壌汚染が原因だったとも伝えられる
entries.official_en:
A village abandoned by its inhabitants when
its soils turned toxic.
entries.canonical_en: An abandoned, forgotten settlement. Some say soil contamination was the cause.

entries.source_jp:
かつてモーザによって滅ぼされた
古代ジール王国がこの地に残した遺跡
entries.official_en:
Ruins left by the ancient Djilu kingdom,
a casualty of the Mosa's aggression.
entries.canonical_en: Ruins of the ancient Djilu Kingdom, which was destroyed by the Mosa.

the Sunbearer.
entries.canonical_en: A pass on a relatively gentle hill, named after Sorell, the Sun God.

entries.official_en:
An underground graveyard near Dagsion.
Often compared to a city due to its size.
entries.canonical_en: An underground communal cemetery near Dagsion, compared to a town because of its enormous size.

A place where it's said that one can

entries.canonical_en: An altar said to be used for secret rites to commune with the spirits of the forest.

entries.source_jp:
英雄アラゴの伝説にも登場する渓谷
瘴気に覆われた危険な場所として知られる
entries.official_en:
A valley made famous in the legend of
Arago, blanketed in thick miasma.
entries.canonical_en: A valley from the legend of the hero Arago, known as a dangerous place shrouded in miasma.

entries.source_jp:
口を開けたような奇岩地形と波の関係で
岩が囁いているように感じられる
entries.official_en:
A formation resembling an open mouth;
waves lap in and out like it's telling secrets.
entries.canonical_en: The unusual mouth-shaped rocks and the waves make it sound as though the rocks are whispering.

entries.source_jp:
古の時代に造られた関所の遺跡
砂漠の出口に睨みを利かせていた
entries.official_en:
Remains of a checkpoint built in antiquity,
glaring at the desert's exit.
entries.canonical_en: Ruins of a checkpoint built in ancient times that once guarded the exit from the desert.

entries.source_jp:
エール山脈の中腹にある巨大湖
ここでしか獲れない魚がいるという
entries.official_en:
A huge lake on the slopes of the Ere
Mountains that hosts unique species of fish.
entries.canonical_en: A huge lake halfway up the Ere Mountains, said to be home to fish found nowhere else.

entries.source_jp:
山脈に沿うように走る街道の峠道
見晴らしが悪く、山賊の噂が絶えない
entries.official_en:
A pass on a highway in the mountains.
The view is poor, and bandits abound.
entries.canonical_en: A pass on a road running alongside the mountains. Visibility is poor, and rumors of bandits never cease.

entries.source_jp:
山脈を縫う道の分岐点にある峠
秘湯を求める湯治客たちの姿が行き交う
entries.official_en:
A pass at a fork in the road, rumored to
lead to secret hot springs.
entries.canonical_en: A pass at a fork in a mountain road, frequented by travelers seeking secluded hot springs.

entries.source_jp:
いつの時代に掘られたか不明な巨大な竪穴
その底には怪我に効く秘湯が湧くという
entries.official_en:
It is not known when this pit was dug, but it
is said to have a hot spring at the bottom.
entries.canonical_en: An enormous pit dug in an unknown age, with a secret hot spring at the bottom said to help heal injuries.

entries.source_jp:
人の侵入を拒絶するかのように深い谷
多くの天馬種たちの住処となっている
entries.official_en:
A deep valley that rejects human intrusion,
home to many species of pegasus.
entries.canonical_en: A deep valley that seems to ward off human visitors, home to many kinds of winged horses.

entries.source_jp:
砂漠の中にありながら、海の近くで
採集できる種類の鉱石がある奇妙な洞窟
entries.official_en:
An anomalous cave that has ores found in
the sea despite being in a desert.
entries.canonical_en: A strange desert cave containing ores of the kinds normally collected near the sea.

entries.source_jp:
潮の流れが複雑で、船乗りたちは
あまり近づきたがらない島々
entries.official_en:
Sailors steer clear of these islands due to
the circuitous currents in their vicinity.
entries.canonical_en: Sailors avoid these islands because the surrounding currents are complex.

entries.source_jp:
砂漠の外縁部の峠道。遠く北の方角に
禁断の地を囲う壁を見ることができる
entries.official_en:
Mountains at the desert's edge, from which
the forbidden land's walls can be seen.
entries.canonical_en: A pass at the edge of the desert. Far to the north, the walls enclosing the forbidden land are visible.

entries.source_jp:
この土地にのみ咲く紫の花は、滅ぼされた
ダマスカルの民の恨みの色といわれている
entries.official_en:
The flowers here are said to have been
colored by the fallen Damascarines' anger.
entries.canonical_en: The purple flowers found only here are said to bear the color of the resentment of Damascar's destroyed people.

entries.source_jp:
パンジャ海流の流れが変わり、
複雑な潮の流れに変化を始める海域
entries.official_en:
Waters where the Pasha Currents change
into a more complex flow.
entries.canonical_en: Waters where the Panja Current changes course and begins to form complex tidal currents.
